findings.description: The new logarithm can raise ValueError when max / multiplier underflows to zero, instead of returning the capped wait.
findings.rationale: For example, multiplier=1e308, max=1e-100, exp_base=2 and attempt_number=1 pass every preceding guard, but the division rounds to 0.0 and math.log(0.0, 2) raises ValueError. Previously this configuration returned 1e-100; now calculating the retry delay crashes.
